title: A directional zero–one law under strict ellipticity
main_claim: For nearest-neighbor random walk in an iid strictly elliptic environment on Z^d, d>=3 (no uniform ellipticity and no moment conditions), P_0(X_n·l -> +infinity) is 0 or 1 for every fixed nonzero real direction l.
coverage:
I read all seven LaTeX sections in build/ (01 to 07) line by line and checked each proof step.
- Sec 2: the column-trial proof of the finite-supremum lemma; the regeneration-word factorization (iid slabs with law W, under the stated word conditions); the renewal proof of finite mean width, including L<=S; and the sign-union lemma.
- Sec 3 (radius proposition): the interval proof of the maximal inequality; the concavity scale choice N(a); the good-prefix bound 4C1*eta+.05<.2; the integrated tail bounds giving eta/(2B)<=lambda<=2eta; the Paley-Zygmund step; the tilted Y-record arithmetic; the template Y-increment a(Mb-1-bC0+(bc-1)k)-M>0; the final height bound (C+2)N-M-cC1N+C0<0; and the fresh-row transfer.
- Sec 4: the antipodality and tail zero-one argument for the rays; the exact-cut bridge law and reversal invariance; the renewal-tail bound u_n-u_{n+1}<=F(n+1); the common-block renewal with E K<=1/(p+p-) and the lateral moments; and the agreement of departure-progress intervals between the two tapes.
- Sec 5: the count-window density u^+u^-/(nP(H_i=h)) and D0<=C; the chain rule D=D0+I(Z;A,B|H)=D0+H(Z|H)-H(d0); the data-processing step I(Z;B|H)<=D0; the buffer-entropy chain and the T range [10n,14n-4]; the reference contact bound via first arrival into Dep(alpha), the common-environment transfer and the two Q^omega cases; the binary divergence inequality; and the dyadic telescoping.
- Sec 6: the posterior-maxima lemma (Ville, entropy <= log(m+1), thresholds b=2B+1, Jensen event-weight bound); fresh-strip equality of the stopped law; unique-prefix counting; the bin bounds aP(V_a)<=Delta and P_omega(D^- and hit D_a)<=2a; and the bin summation giving Delta*log^2(e/Delta).
- Sec 7: identification of the reversed positive list as the bridge plus the independent negative path; the late-first-contact implication on U_l; Delta<=2^{-G}a_l; cut averaging; B_J<=4(A+1/J)log^2 J; the o(J) count of uncovered labels; unconditioning; the depth-to-index label shift; and the final J/log J versus J/loglog J contradiction.
No step failed.
